name: POST /api/empi/candidate-links/:link_id/steward-review - queue for steward
description: Queues a candidate link for human steward adjudication by opening an approval step on the given route_id; the steward identity is taken from the JWT (primary_persona_id, falling back to sub), never from the body. tenant_id falls back to the JWT tenant claim when the body omits it. Edge cases: a missing route_id, or no tenant_id in either the body or the token, -> 400; a candidate link that does not exist throws 'empi: candidate link <id> not found' inside the service and surfaces as a 500 InternalError with that message in details, NOT a 404 - this is the single most misleading status on the route; re-queuing an already-queued link opens a second approval step, so the endpoint is not idempotent; a token with no persona claim yields an empty steward_persona_id rather than an error.

errorCases.when: Authorization header absent or not in the form "Bearer <jwt>"
JWT signature invalid, malformed, or past its exp claim
body.route_id is missing, or tenant_id is absent from both the body and the JWT tenant claim
the link_id in the path matches no candidate-link row — surfaced as a 500 (with the message in details), not a 404
the approval-step insert or any other service call throws

testCases.name: Queue a candidate link for steward review
